options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: performance_profile
options.description: Define the performance profile as I(Compact) or I(HighPerformance). The high performance profile configures a predefined set of parameters for very high performance use cases.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: sdc_id
options.description: ID of the SDC. Specify either I(sdc_name), I(sdc_id) or I(sdc_ip) for get/rename operation. Mutually exclusive with I(sdc_name) and I(sdc_ip).

options.name: sdc_ip
options.description: IP of the SDC. Specify either I(sdc_name), I(sdc_id) or I(sdc_ip) for get/rename operation. Mutually exclusive with I(sdc_id) and I(sdc_name).

options.name: sdc_name
options.description: Name of the SDC. Specify either I(sdc_name), I(sdc_id) or I(sdc_ip) for get/rename operation. Mutually exclusive with I(sdc_id) and I(sdc_ip).

options.name: sdc_new_name
options.description: New name of the SDC. Used to rename the SDC.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
